Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the comparison of locations. The Planner incorrectly stated that Laleli and Ortaköy are both neighborhoods within the same district, Fatih. In reality, Ortaköy is part of the Beşiktaş district, not Fatih. This mistake led to the incorrect conclusion that the Laleli Mosque and Esma Sultan Mansion are located in the same neighborhood.
